name: Dam Safety and Maintenance
description: Dam safety principles; dam safety issues: hydrological, structural and operational safety; sedimentation issues, environmental and social aspects; extreme weather and climate change aspects; design flood review; dam break analysis; dam seepage and seepage control measures; geochemical interactions between dam body and seeping water; guidelines for dam safety inspection; dam safety bill, risk screening framework, dam safety organizations, stakeholders viewpoints, standard operating procedures (SOPs) and emergency preparedness and action plans; dam maintenance and rehabilitation; drainage gallery maintenance; maintenance of spillway body, stilling basin, energy dissipators, outlets, appurtenances, and downstream riverbanks protection structures; maintenance of hydromechanical equipment and dam gates; lighting in dam galleries and dam complex; dam health monitoring; DHARMA; CS and QA system; instrumentation and monitoring for dam safety, automation in dam operation.
